adopted_scope: Bookmark record model and Dexie/IndexedDB persistence layer (source/src/includes/store.ts:3-16, source/src/includes/store.ts:41-47).
Add/edit dialog with Valibot validation and generated ids (source/src/App.tsrx:101-129, source/src/App.tsrx:699-717).
Library list, tabs, tag sidebar, search, sort, and per-card actions (source/src/App.tsrx:58-88, source/src/App.tsrx:178-498).
URL validation, hostname extraction, blob-URL favicon handling, and date formatting (source/src/includes/utils.ts:1-26).
Application mount and static HTML shell (source/src/index.ts:1-9, source/index.html:14-19).
exclusions: No collections/folders or nested organization: organization is a flat string[] tags field only (source/src/includes/store.ts:3-16).
No unsorted/default category: the schema requires at least one tag (source/src/App.tsrx:121-128).
Search is title-only; URL, description, and tags are not searched (source/src/App.tsrx:63-88).
No import/export of browser bookmark HTML or other services' libraries; absent from the manifest.
No cloud sync or multi-device sharing; data is local IndexedDB (source/README.md:13-14).
No preserved page copies or snapshots; only a favicon Blob is stored (source/src/includes/store.ts:8).
No duplicate detection or URL uniqueness constraint; 'url' is not indexed uniquely (source/src/includes/store.ts:45-47).
No broken-link detection or library hygiene features.
No browser extension/bookmarklet; capture is via the in-page add form.
No trash view; Delete exists only for archived records and relies on a transient Undo toast (source/src/App.tsrx:436-453).
shared_scenario_links.reason: The repository implements the scenario's core loop of deliberately saving a URL as a durable record, organizing it, retrieving it later, and returning to the original page. However, the scenario's 'category' (归类) concept maps only onto a mandatory flat tag list rather than creatable/movable collections, there is no default/unsorted category because at least one tag is required, and search covers only the title. Persistence is single-browser IndexedDB with no sync, so the multi-device aspect of the scenario is not supported.
workflow_support: Save a seen link: Add Bookmark dialog captures URL with Valibot validation (source/src/App.tsrx:101-129, source/src/App.tsrx:658-717).
Choose a simple category: up to five free-text tags are entered in the dialog (source/src/App.tsrx:608-657).

Browse or search the personal library: Home/Archived tabs, tag checkbox filters with counts, and a title-search field (source/src/App.tsrx:49-56, source/src/App.tsrx:58-88, source/src/App.tsrx:241-250).
Move/manage organization after saving: Edit reopens the record and rewrites tags via saveBookmark (source/src/App.tsrx:392-412, source/src/App.tsrx:699-714).
Open a record to return to the original page: Visit updates visitedAt/visitCount and calls window.open(item.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') (source/src/App.tsrx:339-354).
Persistence across sessions: records are written to Dexie table 'bookmarks' and re-read with db.bookmarks.toArray() on mount (source/src/includes/store.ts:41-47, source/src/App.tsrx:23-32).
